queries.documents: SELECT provider,url,content_hash,acquired_at,payload FROM source_documents ORDER BY provider,url,content_hash
queries.fetches: SELECT provider,symbols,started_at,ended_at,acquired_at,status,detail FROM information_fetches ORDER BY started_at,ended_at,status,detail::text
queries.filings: SELECT f.id,f.symbol,f.accession,f.form,f.items,f.published_at,f.acquired_at,f.payload,s.content_hash source_hash FROM filing_events f JOIN source_documents s ON s.id=f.source_id ORDER BY f.id
queries.versions: SELECT v.id,v.provider,v.external_id,v.symbols,v.created_at,v.updated_at,v.available_at,v.acquired_at,v.payload,s.content_hash source_hash FROM information_versions v JOIN source_documents s ON s.id=v.source_id ORDER BY v.id
